summary: Withhold optimistic folder batches when observed server-resolved edges differ from raw positions

schema.detail: No wire or journal format change.

compatibility.detail: An observed live folder whose raw parent differs from its shown parent signals server cycle cuts, ancestor lifts or orphan resolution. Every folder batch, including create, move and delete, now retains the observed rows until authoritative readback instead of leaving other resolved edges stale. The pure overlay does not duplicate the daemon resolver. Membership-only overlays remain available.

recovery.detail: No rollback or journal change; authoritative observed projection replaces withheld folder optimism.
